candidates.location_hint: the main content area that swaps between error messages and transaction lists
candidates.why: state changes for failures and successful data loads appear visually but lack announcements for assistive technology users.

candidates.location_hint: the container wrapping the busy indicator and dynamic content
candidates.why: it signals a busy state but does not explicitly announce when that state clears or when new information becomes available.

candidates.location_hint: the retry control in the panel header
candidates.why: focus stays on this control after operations complete, which may leave users uncertain about where to look next or whether the operation succeeded.

candidates.location_hint: the interactive button in the panel header
candidates.why: the blue foreground color against a white background should be verified for minimum contrast ratios, particularly if the rendered text size is small.
it applies both a status role and a live attribute simultaneously, which is redundant and may cause unexpected announcement behavior on some assistive technologies.
